external_genes: unique OGS3 source genes reconstructed from all original fragments
sequence_protocol: Exclude modeling records with exact sequence identity, complete containment in either direction, or at least 50% of an external sequence's distinct 20-mers shared with one modeling record. Check both strands and both classes. Target-gene sharing alone is allowed.
gene_protocol: Additionally exclude every modeling record assigned to any source gene of the original 40 external sequences, including background source genes.
internal_partition: Assign source genes connected by the same 20-mer overlap rule to one component before splitting. Keep the initial partition fixed between external protocols.
selection: All architecture, seed and optimizer settings retained from experiment.json; validation AUC alone selects checkpoints. No external label or score selects a model or hyperparameter.
reporting: Binary classification on the unchanged original external panel. Report both isolation protocols, classification AUC, accuracy and confusion counts; no dsRIP 28-fragment ranking panel.
external_source: Unchanged original release_data/BeetleFormer_external_test.csv; four studies plus OGS3 controls
